Package dev.relism.flash.ext.data.core

Class Data

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.data.core.Data
public final class Data extends Object
Application-facing data gateway. Repositories are created once per entity type and are safe to share: transaction/session state stays in Tx, never in the repository instance.
